inputs.name: daemon_config
inputs.description: Settings for /etc/docker/daemon.json, such as { log-driver = "json-file", log-opts = { max-size = "10m" } }.

inputs.name: docker_users
inputs.description: Existing users to add to the docker group, so they can run docker without sudo.

inputs.name: stacks
inputs.description: Compose files to run, by stack name. Each goes to /opt/stacks/NAME/compose.yaml and runs with docker compose up.
